output.subject: Your question about opening a savings account for your son
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for sharing such a lovely reason for writing. You asked what the minimum amount is to open a kids' savings account. You also mentioned that your son has saved about $140 in a jar and is very excited to put it in the bank. It's wonderful to hear he has been saving so carefully.

We want to give you accurate, up-to-date details rather than a guess, so we have passed your question to our Deposit Operations team. They will look into the minimum opening amount and anything else you may need to know before opening an account for your son. We will respond within 10 business days.

In the meantime, if you have any other questions about getting your son started with saving, please let us know and we will include the answers in our reply.

Thank you again for thinking of us for your son's first savings account. We hope he enjoys watching his savings grow.

Warm regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a product inquiry, not a complaint; consider whether it needs logging as a complaint.
Add the current minimum opening deposit for the kids' savings account, if the bank offers one.
Confirm whether $140 meets the minimum and say so clearly.
Add any ID or documents needed for the parent and child, and whether opening is done in branch or online.
Customer selected the Branch Service topic; check whether they expect to open the account at a branch.
Consider replying sooner than 10 business days, since this is a simple question.
